//: verified-scala3 adapter — Claude Code. Merge this 'hooks' key into .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json (global). install-hooks.sh does the merge for you. $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR keeps the path project-relative, so the same fragment works in every repo that vendors the schema. $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID is set in the hook process's environment (verified directly, schema v12 gate-payload spec) and scopes gate.sh's per-session suppression and the completion gate's bounded refusal. Tier B (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit) never blocks. Tier A (PostToolUse, Stop) is the promoted tier, added at spec:hook-tiers — PostToolUse never blocks either; Stop is the one hook in this file that can, via gate.sh's own bounded-refusal + escape-hatch (VERIFIED_SCALA3_HOOKS=off) discipline. Both read tool_input.file_path / transcript_path / stop_hook_active from the JSON Claude Code already pipes to the command's stdin — gate.sh needs no extra flags here, matching the 'adapter decides when to ask, script decides what' rule.
